name: halfphi
what: The switch-level engine: die-data parser, netlist, solver. It names no chip and embeds no die data, which is the whole reason it can be depended on freely. Loads the 6502, the 6800 and the Z80 through identical calls.
not_hosted_because: A crate is a dependency, not a running service. There is nothing to answer an HTTP request, so this piece has no reachability to report.

name: the 6502 info site
what: The info site: a WebGL2 die renderer, around 25 derived container kinds, the chip map, the primer, the labs and the measured tables.
ships_as: built into a content-hashed dist/, served from a release symlink
data_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived from visual6502 die data

name: the 6502 API
what: Stateless HTTP over the real chip: the whole machine travels in every request and the server keeps no sessions. FastAPI and Pydantic, plus the chip atlas, the cartridge mint and an MCP endpoint.
data_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived from visual6502 die data

name: halfwave
what: The warm engine process the API talks to: a line protocol, one parsed netlist, one machine, zero dependencies. Plus a reviewer-built lab on a property of its own.
ships_as: a release binary, plus a static lab
data_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived from visual6502 die data

name: Die Runner
what: The console: a 6502 ROM, a page of its memory as the screen, and the browser drawing it. Cartridges, builder pages and the editor.
data_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived from visual6502 die data

name: Die Runner API
what: The cartridge mint, the console spec and the registry. Publishing re-runs every cartridge on the chip rather than believing the verify block the file arrived with, because a file is something its author can edit.
ships_as: routes on the same FastAPI app as the 6502 API, not a service of its own
data_terms: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, derived from visual6502 die data
not_hosted_because: Not a separate service. It is routes on the 6502 API, so probing it would report that service's health a second time under a different name. See the chip-api piece.
